chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Said from Ibn Abi Umayr from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)

Regarding a man who buys a slave girl, frees her, and then marries her: Does the marriage consummation take effect upon her before she completes her waiting period (istibra')? He said: 'He completes her istibra' with one menstruation.' I said: 'And if he has intercourse with her [before that]?' He said: 'There is no harm.'
ai.seo_question: What is the waiting period for a freed slave girl who is married by her former master?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq clarifies the istibra' (waiting period) for a freed slave girl, establishing that a single menstruation suffices to confirm her status, a ruling distinct from the three periods required for free women. It further affirms that early consummation does not invalidate the marriage, reflecting the practical legal flexibility in early Shia jurisprudence regarding the transition of status from slavery to freedom.
